Code under the main guard only runs when you execute the file directly, like python script.py. If another module imports it, that block is skipped, so you can import its functions without kicking off the command line logic.
The main guard stops the module from running any code at all when it is imported, so imports have no side effects, and it also makes the script run faster because Python compiles it differently.
